independentSourceAndPixelObservations: Original crop opened once. Two side-by-side panels contain thirteen connected dipoles each, with twenty-six circled charge signs per panel. Each inner dielectric has a hatched sampling rectangle containing three positive and three negative charge centers. Panel a preserves varied orientations and unsigned terminal leads; panel b has left-positive/right-negative plate signs and varied tilted dipoles with a rightward bias. No source numerical scale or field arrow is printed.

The inspected final spec maps every circled charge to its pair connector, signed center displacement and dielectric containment. Sampling rectangles retain the three-plus/three-minus center inventory. Rim endpoints are collinear with charge centers and lie on the corresponding circles. Vertical panel stacking, connector clearance and hatch spacing are modern uncalibrated layout; the varied directions are not universal full alignment or free charge transport.
